gate.title: Annual fee, expense and carried-interest disclosure by the fund vehicle
gate.quote: The General Partner shall provide such information solely to the extent it is tracked by the General Partner in the ordinary course and can be provided without incremental expense to the General Partner or the Fund.
gate.why: § 7514.7(a) says the public fund 'shall require' the disclosures. The text has no cost-based exception.

gate.title: Annual fee, expense and carried-interest disclosure by the fund vehicle
gate.quote: The General Partner shall provide such information solely to the extent it is tracked by the General Partner in the ordinary course and can be provided without incremental expense to the General Partner or the Fund.
gate.why: Limits the disclosure to what the manager already tracks. § 7514.7(a) has no such limit.

gate.title: Annual fee, expense and carried-interest disclosure by the fund vehicle
gate.quote: The General Partner shall use commercially reasonable efforts to provide the Investor, annually, with the information described in California Government Code Section 7514.7, including the Investor's pro rata share of fees and expenses paid from the Fund to the General Partner and the Investor's pro rata share of carried interest distributed to the General Partner.
gate.why: 'Reasonable efforts' appears only in § 7514.7(d)(2), for pre-2017 contracts, and it is the public fund's own duty, not a standard for the manager.

gate.title: Annual fee, expense and carried-interest disclosure by the fund vehicle
gate.why: Not named in the clause: (a)(1) fees and expenses paid directly; (a)(4) pro rata share of portfolio-company fees and expenses.

gate.title: Public Records Act: fund-level items that stay disclosable
gate.quote: The Investor may disclose the name and vintage year of the Fund, the amount of the Investor's Commitment, the amount of the Investor's contributions and distributions, and the net internal rate of return of the Fund; provided that, before making any such disclosure, the Investor shall obtain the prior written consent of the General Partner and deliver to the General Partner an opinion of counsel that the disclosure is required by law.
gate.why: Makes a statutory disclosure depend on the manager's consent. § 7928.710(c) says the listed items are 'subject to disclosure'. (That a consent condition is improper is an attorney judgment; the statute does not mention side-letter conditions.)

gate.title: Public Records Act: fund-level items that stay disclosable
gate.quote: The Investor may disclose the name and vintage year of the Fund, the amount of the Investor's Commitment, the amount of the Investor's contributions and distributions, and the net internal rate of return of the Fund; provided that, before making any such disclosure, the Investor shall obtain the prior written consent of the General Partner and deliver to the General Partner an opinion of counsel that the disclosure is required by law.
gate.why: Makes a statutory disclosure depend on a legal opinion. Same note as above.

gate.title: Public Records Act: fund-level items that stay disclosable
gate.quote: The General Partner acknowledges that the Investor is subject to public records laws, including California Government Code Section 6254.26.
gate.why: Cites the pre-2023 section number. The current section is § 7928.710 (operative January 1, 2023). The old number was not re-read in this build.

gate.title: Indemnification by a public fund (gift and lending-of-credit clause)
gate.quote: The Investor shall indemnify the General Partner and the Fund against any losses arising from a breach of the Investor's representations in its subscription agreement, without limitation as to amount.
gate.why: Uncapped indemnity from a public fund. Art. XVI § 6 restricts gifts of public money and lending of public credit; whether and how it limits an LP indemnity is an attorney judgment.
